scope: Reiko Fukuzawa's water and social-media stories in Steam fukuzawa.ks. Names are locked after wiki verification; asset IDs remain untouched.

entries.role: First-year high-school student from Gifu Prefecture and storyteller
entries.note: Cheerful, chatty, teasing delivery that readily turns to disturbing material. Kiwame places her at another school in Gifu; do not import Narugami membership from a different continuity.

entries.role: Former second-year student in the contaminated-water story
entries.note: Extremely concerned about cleanliness; carries mineral water and avoids touching things directly. Preserve Reiko's judgments as her speech.

entries.role: Student at Reiko's older sister's school, aspiring idol, and Poetter personality
entries.note: Wiki explicitly reads the surname Shita. Keep Shita despite the internal sida asset ID. Her perceived kindness and relationship with Tamai vary by branch; preserve each version and its gradual revelations.

entries.role: Shita's close companion; edits her photographs and writes her Poetter posts in the social-media branch
entries.note: Wealthy and intensely attached to Shita. Branches interpret their bond differently. Preserve the source's body-shaming insults without making those insults an objective editorial description.
Short-post service modeled on Twitter. Keep this fictional name; do not replace it with a current real service.

A coined name for a short Poetter message. Reiko explicitly defines it and derives it from poem at2261–62. Use quotation marks at its introduction; ordinary posting can still use post when the source says 投稿.
Distinguish the rooftop water tank from the reservoir, 貯水池, and the lake. Use reservoir for 貯水池.
Use tap water for 水道の水/水道水. A drinking fountain may have several taps; preserve the specified second tap from the right.

Preserve the distinction between the building, the rooftop water tank it houses, the pipes and the reservoir. The source's 屋上のある at3614 is interpreted as the tank on the roof from the explicit surrounding context.
